Only additions: apps/mobile/__tests__/adv/{accessStoreStateConsistency,appStoreHydrateOrdering,consentAndSessionRaces}.adv.test.ts — no production code or existing tests touched, no breaks fixed. Nominal area paths apps/mobile/src/store and apps/mobile/src/access do not exist at this SHA; the real state surface is apps/mobile/src/state/{accessStore,appStore,consentStore}.ts + src/data/accountScope.ts + src/account/apiSession.ts + src/billing/{pendingFulfilment,accessApi,lifecycle}.ts, which is what was attacked.

EVIDENCE (all VERIFIED, run in apps/mobile after `npm ci` exit 0):
- `npx jest --ci --runInBand __tests__/adv/` -> exit 1; 3 suites; 23 tests: 19 passed, 4 failed, 0 skipped, 0 todo. Log: https://la-hacks-rttothemoon.devinenterprise.com/attachments/66683177-f72c-473f-abfa-6b128ae6b46b/adv-state-consistency-jest.log (the 4 failures are the preserved reproductions listed in `breaks`).
- `npx tsc --noEmit` -> exit 0. `npx prettier --check __tests__/adv/` -> exit 0. Root `npx eslint apps/mobile/__tests__/adv/` -> exit 0 (apps/mobile-local eslint 8.57 crashes loading @typescript-eslint/no-unused-expressions from the root eslint 9 tree — pre-existing tooling mismatch, not caused by these files; AGENTS.md names the root `eslint .` as the authority).
- Baseline existing suite `npx jest --ci --silent __tests__/accessStore.test.ts` -> exit 0; 14 passed.

CONFIRMED BREAKS (4): see `breaks` — A1 (P2), H2 (P2), H1 (P3), C2 (P3).

ATTACKS THAT DID NOT BREAK (19, each `cd apps/mobile && npx jest --ci --runInBand <file> -t '<id> '`, all pass):
accessStoreStateConsistency.adv.test.ts — A1b stale 'checking' tracker clears only via lifecycle reconcile after the 10 s cooldown (characterises A1 recovery); A2 reset() during in-flight refreshAccess drops the late snapshot and the store re-initialises; A3 paid snapshot for owner A resolving after reconfigure for owner B never reaches B (canonicalAccess null, status idle); A4 two concurrent initialize() perform one getAccess + one store.configure and settle ready; A5 purchaseSelected() during in-flight refresh is refused without opening the store, refresh still publishes; A6 purchase with malformed transaction evidence ('' transactionId, non-ISO purchasedAt) stays a durable pending purchase (attempts 1 -> 2 across sign-out/relaunch), never re-charges (store.purchase called once total), retryPendingFulfilment clears it once the server says premium; A7 clearError() during pending recovery keeps pendingFulfilment/fulfilmentStatus and does not reopen the store; A8 RevenueCat configure() failure during initialize keeps server access authoritative (premium stays true, plans null, error billing.unconfigured, purchase refused without calling store); A9 getAccess exceeding BILLING_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS fails closed (status error, canonicalAccess null, retryable) and the late paid payload is discarded, refreshAccess then recovers; A10 structurally invalid pending record from storage (attempts 40) fails closed: fulfilmentStatus unavailable, getAccess/syncBilling never called, purchase and restore refused, record left untouched.
appStoreHydrateOrdering.adv.test.ts — H1b stale canonical profile resolving after completeOnboarding saved newer answers never replaces them (store + kv keep the answers); H3 local kv write failure after successful canonical save still publishes the profile (hydrated, onboardingError null) and re-hydrate reads canonical; H4 corrupt local profile bytes + canonical fetch failure -> hydrated true, profile null, hydrateError set, corrupt bytes retained; H5 pre-auth onboarding stash for a different owner is not adopted by the signed-in owner; H6 A->B switch while A's canonical fetch is in flight: A's profile never lands under B (fenced by owner generation).
consentAndSessionRaces.adv.test.ts — C1 grant response for A landing after sign-out + B sign-in never marks B consenting; C3 withdraw resolving after A signed out and back in (new owner generation) is dropped, fresh read wins; C4 double-tapped grant performs one request and a bearer rotation mid-flight does not drop its result; S1 reportApiUnauthorized for a rotated-out or cleared bearer is ignored, only the live bearer tears down the session.

(2) A10 fail-closed state has no in-app recovery path for a permanently corrupt pending row (only account deletion discards it) — by design per the 'never fabricate completed payment recovery' invariant, flagged for coordinator awareness only.
